title: Color Correction
description: Lightweight client-side color correction for Minecraft 26.2 on Fabric
body:
# ColorCorrection

Lightweight client-side color correction for Minecraft 26.2 on Fabric.

ColorCorrection adds an in-game tuning screen for display color adjustments without changing world data, textures, resource packs, or server behavior. It is meant for players who want quick visual calibration for brightness, contrast, temperature, hue, and RGB channels while keeping the mod small and simple.

## Features

- Real post-process color correction for the rendered image
- Brightness, contrast, temperature, hue, and RGB channel controls
- Strength slider for subtle or stronger correction
- Compact live preview panel for tuning while looking at the world
- Transparent settings screen background so the scene stays visible
- Client-side only: no server install required
- No Fabric API requirement
- Small jar and no performance decrease

## Controls

Press `F8` in game to open the ColorCorrection menu.

Use the preview button in the bottom-right of the menu to move the controls to the right side of the screen and tune the image while looking around.

## Compatibility

ColorCorrection is designed for Minecraft `26.2` with Fabric Loader `0.19.3` or newer.

The effect is applied as a Minecraft post-process pass instead of a full-screen GUI overlay. It should work with normal OpenGL rendering and is built to avoid hard crashes when renderer internals are changed by other mods.

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft `26.2`.
2. Put the ColorCorrection jar into your `mods` folder.
3. Launch the game and press `F8`.

## Notes

This mod only changes how the game is displayed on your client. It does not edit screenshots after capture, does not modify textures, and does not affect other players.

Author: `Teiwazik`
